name: Finding the Shadowy Figure
summary: Sven Yorgen's farm has been devastated, and Finding the Shadowy Figure turns toward the stranger who fled it. Tavernkeep Smitts points the search west from Darkshire into Duskwood's haunted woods.

sections.title: On the Trail of a Ghost
sections.body: Sven Yorgen pleads for help identifying the figure who fled his devastated homestead. The trail leads to the Scarlet Raven Tavern, where Tavernkeep Smitts offers several clues. The fugitive was a complete stranger to Darkshire, nervous and jittery, and left the faint lamps at the town's edge in haste. He vanished into the wilderness to the west.

sections.title: Unmasking Jitters
sections.body: Jitters is found shivering among Duskwood's dangers, after the stranger's trail leads west. Shown the diary recovered from the ruined farm, he confesses that he wrote the tattered journal. Jitters is a terrified witness who fled the horrors unleashed on the region, not a calculated villain. He hints that the diary holds only part of the nightmare.

faq.answer: The shadowy figure is Jitters, a skittish wanderer who wrote about the dark events around Sven Yorgen's farm before fleeing west into the woods.

faq.q: Where does Tavernkeep Smitts say the figure went?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts says the man was a stranger to Darkshire, visibly terrified, and fled west into the wilderness.

faq.q: Why was Jitters running from Sven's farm?
faq.answer: Jitters witnessed horrors strike Sven's farm and fled for his life, afraid that whatever destroyed Sven's family would come for him next.

faq.q: What is the book found at Sven's farm?
faq.answer: The book found at Sven's farm is a journal written by Jitters about the ominous events before the massacre. Jitters admits it tells only half the story.
Jitters is in the western wilds of Duskwood, near the Raven Hill encampment, away from Darkshire and the forest's prowling beasts.
After confessing that he wrote the journal, Jitters prepares a complete account of what happened and sends you back to Sven Yorgen with the truth.

angles.text: For the Alliance, learning why Jitters fled matters to understanding the growing darkness threatening the kingdom's southern frontier.
As a rogue, you rely on keen observation and tracking to follow a panicked suspect through dense, shadow-draped woods and separate rumor from true tracks.
